claims.claim: 2024-11-13: At its investor event Mastercard set 2025-2027 three-year performance objectives of mid-teens EPS CAGR, after a 2024 restructuring charge.
claims.quote: 2025-2027 3-Year CAGR EPS 1 Forecasted GAAP Mid-teens
claims.title: Mastercard Incorporated Non-GAAP Reconciliation 2025-2027 performance objectives (8-K Exhibit 99.1)
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Same exhibit references a restructuring charge of $0.16 per diluted share in the nine months ended Sep 30, 2024.

claims.claim: 2024 (Q3/Q4): Mastercard recorded a $190 million restructuring charge intended to streamline the organization.
claims.quote: During 2024, we recorded a restructuring charge of $190 million ($147 million after tax, or $0.16 per diluted share).
claims.title: Mastercard Incorporated Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.label: Verified

claims.claim: 2024-12: Mastercard closed its acquisition of Recorded Future (threat intelligence) for $2.7 billion cash.
claims.quote: In December 2024, Mastercard acquired a 100 % equity interest in RF Ultimate Parent, Inc. (“Recorded Future”), a global threat intelligence company
claims.title: Mastercard Incorporated Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Goodwill of $1.7 billion; expected to add threat intelligence to identity, fraud prevention, real-time decisioning and cybersecurity services.

claims.claim: 2025: Mastercard completed no business acquisitions during calendar 2025, per its 10-K.
claims.quote: In 2025, the Company did not complete any business acquisitions. In 2024, the Company acquired businesses for total cash consideration of $ 2.8 billion.
claims.title: Mastercard Incorporated Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Any 2025 press reports of Mastercard acquisitions (e.g. stablecoin infrastructure) had not closed by Dec 31, 2025 per this filing.

claims.claim: 2025-02-06: The board's HR & Compensation Committee raised CEO Michael Miebach's base salary to $1.4 million and bonus target to 250%, effective March 1, 2025.
claims.quote: Michael Miebach Chief Executive Officer $1,250,000 $1,400,000 200% 250%
claims.title: Mastercard Incorporated Form 8-K dated February 6, 2025 (Item 5.02)
claims.label: Verified

claims.claim: 2025-02-26: Chief Administrative Officer Tim Murphy moved to Vice Chair and Richard Verma re-joined as CAO, both effective May 1, 2025.
claims.quote: Timothy Murphy, 57, a Named Executive Officer and the Company’s Chief Administrative Officer, will transition from his current role to the role of Vice Chair
claims.title: Mastercard Incorporated Form 8-K dated February 25, 2025 (Item 5.02)
claims.label: Verified

claims.claim: 2025: Mastercard launched Agent Pay for agentic commerce, enabled all U.S. cardholders, and scheduled a global launch for early 2026; merchants participate without significant integration.
claims.quote: In 2025, we enabled all U.S.-based Mastercard cardholders to participate in this program, with a global launch scheduled for early 2026.
claims.title: Mastercard Incorporated Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Builds on Agentic Tokens and dispute management capabilities.

claims.claim: 2025: Mastercard expanded stablecoin support: roughly 130 crypto co-brand card programs and stablecoins embedded into Mastercard Move for send/receive flows.
claims.quote: Embedding stablecoins into our Mastercard Move platform, which allows customers to send and receive stablecoin flows seamlessly
claims.title: Mastercard Incorporated Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: 10-K also states approximately 40% of all Mastercard transactions are now tokenized.

claims.claim: 2025: Mastercard launched Mastercard Threat Intelligence (built on Recorded Future), Merchant Cloud, Commerce Media and announced Account-to-Account Protect.
claims.quote: In 2025, we launched Merchant Cloud, a unified platform designed to offer a single point of entry to cutting-edge payment services
claims.title: Mastercard Incorporated Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.label: Verified

claims.claim: 2025: Mastercard said its virtual card technology was embedded in more than 10 global B2B and T&E platforms, more than double 2024, for issuer and business integration.
claims.quote: we had embedded our virtual card technology in more than 10 global B2B and travel and expense platforms
claims.title: Mastercard Incorporated Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Filing adds: more than double the number of platforms in 2024.

claims.claim: 2025-05: The U.K. trial court approved the £200 million settlement of the U.K. consumer class action; Mastercard paid $263 million.
claims.quote: in May 2025, the trial court issued their written approval of the settlement. Following the trial court’s written approval, Mastercard paid
claims.title: Mastercard Incorporated Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Settlement entered December 2024; litigation funder seeking judicial review of the allocation between class and funder.

claims.claim: 2025-06: The U.K. merchant interchange trial court decided against Mastercard on certain issues; about £0.3 billion of unresolved U.K./Pan-European merchant damages claims remain.
claims.quote: approximately £ 0.3 billion (approximately $ 0.4 billion as of December 31, 2025) of unresolved damages claims remain.
claims.title: Mastercard Incorporated Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.label: Verified

claims.claim: 2025-07: Mastercard and Visa were served with a proposed Dutch merchant collective action over interregional interchange fees since 1992, seeking over EUR 0.3 billion.
claims.quote: In July 2025, Mastercard and Visa were served with a proposed collective action in the Netherlands on behalf of Dutch merchants.
claims.title: Mastercard Incorporated Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: A Portuguese consumer collective action (~EUR 0.4 billion) is also pending.

claims.claim: 2025-Q2: Mastercard accrued $79 million for the long-running ATM operators' non-discrimination-rule surcharge class litigation, which alleges over $1 billion in single damages.
claims.quote: the second quarter of 2025, Mastercard recorded an accrual of $ 79 million in connection with this matter.
claims.title: Mastercard Incorporated Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: ATM Operators Class Complaint filed 2011 in D.D.C. against Mastercard and Visa; ongoing.

claims.claim: 2025-08/09: Two U.S. federal district courts issued conflicting rulings on the Regulation II debit interchange cap; the cap remains in effect pending litigation.
claims.quote: One court vacated the interchange cap while the other upheld it. The interchange cap remains in effect while the litigation continues.
claims.title: Mastercard Incorporated Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.label: Verified

claims.claim: 2025-07 and 2025-11: EU revised its systemic-importance regulation (cyber resilience, outsourcing) and Brazil's central bank issued a PSO regulation requiring networks to extend settlement guarantees to non-guaranteed transactions.
claims.quote: requires payment networks to extend their settlement guarantees to previously non-guaranteed transactions (such as merchant installment transactions)
claims.title: Mastercard Incorporated Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Brazil implementation expected to conclude by November 2026. New Zealand cross-border interchange caps effective May 2026 also noted.

claims.claim: 2025-11-10: Mastercard and Visa signed a Superseding and Amended Rule 23(b)(2) class settlement with U.S. merchants in the MDL 1720 interchange litigation, replacing the 2024 deal the court rejected.
claims.quote: Superseding and Amended Rule 23(b)(2) Class Settlement Agreement”) is made as of the 10th day of November, 2025
claims.title: Superseding and Amended Class Settlement Agreement of the Rule 23(b)(2) Class Plaintiffs and the Defendants (8-K Exhibit 99.1)
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Appendices include Permissible Steering Scenarios and Mastercard credit interchange rates as of March 2025. Per the 10-K, preliminary-approval briefing was complete and the court's decision pending as of Feb 2026; Mastercard accrued $637 million for U.S. MDL cases.

claims.claim: 2025: Mastercard recorded $504 million of litigation provisions, tied to opt-out merchants, the U.S. EMV liability-shift case and the ATM surcharge complaints.
claims.quote: During 2025, we recorded pre-tax charges of $504 million ($357 million after tax, or $0.39 per diluted share)
claims.title: Mastercard Incorporated Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.label: Verified

claims.claim: Ongoing into 2026: A 2023 U.S. DOJ civil investigative demand into Mastercard's U.S. debit program and a 2024 European Commission request on network fees charged to acquirers remain open.
claims.quote: The request focuses on Mastercard’s practices regarding network fees related to acquirers. Mastercard is cooperating with the European Commission
claims.title: Mastercard Incorporated Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: ACCC (Australia) debit-agreements case: liability hearing scheduled April 2026.

claims.claim: 2025-11-07: Mastercard amended and restated its $8 billion five-year unsecured revolving credit facility, now expiring November 7, 2030.
claims.quote: The Credit Facility, which expires on November 7, 2030, amends and restates the Company’s prior $8,000,000,000 credit facility
claims.title: Mastercard Incorporated Form 8-K dated November 7, 2025 (Item 1.01)
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Corporate finance item; included for completeness of the timeline.

claims.claim: 2026-05-07: Corporate Controller Sandra Arkell moves to Chief Audit Executive and Chris Mullett (CFO Europe) becomes Corporate Controller, effective August 3, 2026.
claims.quote: Chris Mullett will be appointed to succeed Ms. Arkell as Corporate Controller and principal accounting officer of the Company.
claims.title: Mastercard Incorporated Form 8-K dated May 5, 2026 (Item 5.02)
claims.label: Verified

claims.claim: 2026-06-02: Mastercard announced a leadership reshuffle effective August 3, 2026: Ling Hai becomes CFO, Sachin Mehra becomes Chief Business Officer over country operations and partnerships, Linda Kirkpatrick becomes Chief Services Officer.
claims.quote: Ling Hai , President of Asia Pacific, Europe, Middle East and Africa, will become Chief Financial Officer, succeeding Sachin Mehra.
claims.title: Mastercard announces leadership updates to advance strategy and support continued growth (8-K Exhibit 99.1)
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Also: Dimi Dosis to Chief Commercial Payments Officer; Craig Vosburg to Vice Chair; Raj Seshadri to Senior Strategic Advisor; Tim Murphy retires October 2026; customer focus unified under one team.

claims.claim: 2026-06-02: Mastercard consolidated customer-facing functions into a single global go-to-market structure (Sales Enablement, Global Partnerships, Digital Commercialization) under the new Chief Business Officer.
claims.quote: Sales Enablement, Global Partnerships, and Digital Commercialization under a single global go-to-market leadership structure.
claims.title: Mastercard announces leadership updates to advance strategy and support continued growth (8-K Exhibit 99.1)
claims.label: Verified

claims.claim: 2026-07-30: Q2 2026 results cited new partnerships in Mexico and the UAE and a 'market-first' Agentic Payment capability; payment network rebates and incentives to customers rose 22%.
claims.quote: From new partnerships in Mexico and the UAE to our market-first Agentic Payment capability, we’re unlocking opportunities unique to Mastercard
claims.title: Mastercard Incorporated Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results (8-K Exhibit 99.1)
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Net revenue $9.3B (+14%); 3.7 billion Mastercard and Maestro cards issued as of June 30, 2026; rebates and incentives +22% on new and renewed deals.
